content: Mech part data models: BattleTech/MechWarrior use per-location armor and internal structure with components occupying slots in locations; damage flows armor -> structure -> critical hits on slotted components; destroyed locations lose their components; salvage adds parts. HBS BattleTech stores mech/part definitions as data files (MechDef, ChassisDef, ComponentDef). Inventory design: consistent item schema (id, classification, attributes, durability). Only partially verified.
